reviews.text: We bring all of our animals here, and have for many years. They’re very upfront with the charges, and get permission before care. Fair prices for the area. Excellent care.

They were really awesome and the best part they were compassionate about my situation.  It’s not all the time that you get that vibe. The Tech was knowledgeable on how to administer meds when I get home. Now on another note the Dr. P was very pleasant to look at. lol
I would recommend to friends and family
My Ziggy is doing better and look forward to the follow up. 😉

Very efficient Vet Clinic from receptionist to Vet MD . Cesar is very polite and knowlegable. Manager Sarah is outstanding . Dr. Polosetski listens to all issues and addresses them effectively . Been with this Vet Clinic greater than 20 years .

Feta is always loved when we come in through those doors! Even when I have dumb new kitty parent questions like how to trim her nails. There's no judgement, just legit education to a new pet owner. Everyone is so lovely! You could tell they really love their job!

10/18/26 Visit:

Again, Dr Polo and his team are amazing and I completely trust him with my dog, Marley!!

My dog got injured and had to go to the ER the night before. Unfortunately, the process the ER did was less invasive, but created more pain for my dog and made him more susceptible to infection.  Dr Polo and his team were able to get us in on a Friday which I am very thankful for and get Marley sedated and do the procedure properly. The limping has greatly subsided, and the surgical site is looking good and healed!!🙏

Dr. Polo is always so patient and kind even when I know I can be a little spastic at times. He got not only the incident but the history with Marley and did x-rays as well As I mentioned, he had problems with limping intermittently leading up to this other injury.

I am so thankful and blessed for Dr. Polo and the rest of the team at This visit we were helped by Dr Polo, Cesar, Forest, and Dani (so sweet and loving with Marley).

I hope this review is coherent. I’m using speech to text and running a little late. Thank you so much Dr Polo and TEAM at Black Mountain Animal Hospital!!🦮💝🫶🙏💕

******************

Once again Dr.Polo was AMAZING!! He is so knowledgeable and trustworthy.🙏 His whole staff/team at the clinic are also amazing and friendly to the pets and the humans!! ❤️
Thank you all, you are truly a blessing!!🦮🙏💕

A friend referred to Dr. Polo at Black Mountain Animal Hospital, and I am so thankful!! Dr. Polo is the best, and the staff are all super friendly and professional as well!

I paid in advance for the petco rewards for discounted grooming and free vet visits; but have had such bad experiences there, I rather pay for the office visit and drive, passing at least 3 petco offices to take my precious pup to Dr. Polo. I trust Dr.Polo, the prices are fair and he is great with my dog. Thanks team!

Absolutely the BEST pet hospital I've ever taken my four legged friends to. They adore animals, are always cheerful and good-humored, and have worked near miracles on my current cat family (Mom and Dad 16, son 15). I've been to some great vets over the years -- this is absolutely superb. Dr.Polostski is just amazing. Can I give it TEN stars????
I brought both of my German shepherds here. The vets are really nice and know how to work with nervous dogs.
Wonderful, caring staff and reasonable rates. Have recommended to all my pet-owner friends.

Best Vet in ALL of San Diego, and beyond! take your pets here, they'll be well cared for and you'll appreciate their flexibility with scheduling and also affordable, really! Thx Dr Polo + excellent staff!!!
Felt like taking priority of the pets health was last priority but instead it was like negotiating with a used car dealership

Black Mountain Road Pet Clinic is the only pet clinic,  I’ve always chosen to take all my pets to for all their pet care health needs over the years. They have always treated all my fur babies, as they were their own. Bella is the 3rd dog, I’ve taken for care since the Early 2000’s.Whether it be a dental exam, growth removals, yearly check up’s and /or vaccinations Black Mountain Road Pet Clinic has always been my trustworthy go too clinic. I know my babies are getting the best care.  Sarah is my all time favorite technician. She is always so professional, kind, and shows so much care and compassion when working with my dogs throughout the years. She is always greeted with wiggle butts, tail wags, and sweet puppy kisses.

Black Mtn Pet Clinic has always been amazing. The entire team is consistently friendly, patient, and so caring every time we bring our fur baby in. This morning we thought we were dealing with an emergency, and both the doctor and staff were incredibly kind and helped put us at ease right away. Their compassion and professionalism show in every visit. Always the best service — we highly recommend them. 💛🐾
Very attentive and knowledgeable staff.  Vet and tech were great with my dogs.  I came alone with 2 so they were very helpful when it came to taking care of each dog.

Dr. Robertson and Cesar worked on my pet when I brought him in for a sick visit. They were extremely nice and very receptive to my concerns. They were kind and gentle with my pet. I was initially nervous to bring my pet to the vet, because of previous poor experience at a different Veterinary office. Now, I am so happy I chose this facility. Every staff member I have interacted with was friendly and understanding. When we received the results of my pets labs, I spoke to Sarah on the phone, she took the time to walk me through everything and patiently answered all my questions. I would highly recommend Veterinary office, and plan to continue bringing my pets here! And thank you to all the staff who helped me take care of my pet!
My experience with the staff & the doctor for my dog was great!   The doctor is very caring &  took his time to thoroughly explain & understand my dog’s situation. Thank you, to all of you!

Dr. Polosetski and his team have all been so kind and courteous when caring for my cats. I’ve had nothing but great experiences when bringing them in to see Dani, Sarah, Ivonne, Forrest and Cesar. Alyssa has been very helpful over the phone/email when questions come up. They’ve gone above and beyond multiple times to fit us in to their schedule when my cats needed it. Thank you BMAH!
The staff and Dr. Polo listened and were very caring and addressed allmy concerns.
Compassionate and professional care, efficient and attentive!

My cat got out and I thought lost forever. I emailed Black Mountain a flyer. They put it up in their window, and literally the same day a Good Samaritan saw it brought them my cat. We have been reunited thanks to this clinic. I cannot put into words how thankful I am for their simple act of kindness. They obviously love animals.

My nervous GSD, Simba, is terrified of the vet.  But at BMAH they treat him with such loving kindness.  Thank you so much to Sarah and Paxton for seeing Simba on such short notice to treat a sudden skin infection.  I truly appreciate all of you.

I am very happy with Ginger’s first puppy visit. We went over a lot and started her on the usual preventative care. Forrest did all the preliminary intake and vitals for her. He was super gentle and sweet with her.  Then I met with Dr. Paxton who was equally caring and kind. She went over several things about my concerns, and then the routine items too. She really listened and explained things well. I feel like Ginger had excellent care here, and I look forward to bringing her again.  Thank you so much.
The staff here have been exceptional when managing our pet’s health. They answer the phones promptly, are helpful in providing estimates, and most importantly, treat our pets kindly.
Professional and friendly staff! Everyone was welcoming, helpful, and caring. Highly recommend!

Staff are friendly and were gentle with my dog. He was scared and shaking during his visit and did not want to stay on the examination table. The vet saw this and did the rest of the examination on the floor with me holding him. He was less scared and stopped shaking. They were also great about explaining what he needed and gave some good recommendations.

Forest is one of the front desk reception staff. He has great customer service in person and conveys great phone etiquette. This veterinarian and their staff was affordable comparing to the corporate franchise locations. Highly recommended.

We had a great experience bringing our Golden Retriever puppy here for his first vaccinations. The staff was friendly, professional, and treated our puppy with great care. Everything was explained clearly, and we felt very comfortable throughout the visit. Highly recommend!

***Alyssa 7/02/26, Thank you for your kind words and those of your team (the card).  It touched all of us in my family as we read.  Thank you
*********Today (6/23/2026) has been a tough day but Dr. Polosetski, Sarah, and Forest helped me on short notice get the answers needed in all but 2 hours.  Special ‘Thank You’ to Sarah for squeezing us in this A.M. and to Forest for being compassionate and very respectful to our dog.  Our 12 yr old Peet (dog) had been showing progressing lethargy from June 6.   From the start, 2 other places (4 visits combined) were focused on spine inflammation and therefore rest, steroids, Gabapentin and a muscle relaxant. However, after all that, Dr. Polosetski this morning diagnosed advanced, terminal lung cancer.  He is a very matter-of-fact doctor, geared more at finding answers and straight-up saying what tests are priority to run.  Without this, we were chasing the belief that our dog just needed bed rest and meds.  In reality, he needed to be put out of his suffering and Dr. Polosetski made that clear too (he was euthanized at home later this afternoon).  Not easy for Dr. to say and not easy to hear after false based hope but I really appreciate him clearing up the ambiguity and falls hope we were running with.  Thank you Black Mtn Animal for getting the answers we needed to carry out our final pet responsibility and for having a team that nicely balances each other.

Came in for an emergency with my 17 year old senior dog. Doctor was very realistic with me, and understanding. Forrest the vet tech is wonderful and compassionate. Very much appreciated their kindness and approach.

Jessica, thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are disappointed to see that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Because no additional details were included, we are unable to understand what may have led to your rating. We are committed to providing compassionate care, clear communication, and excellent service to every client and patient, and we are always looking for ways to improve.

We appreciate your feedback and thank you for giving us the opportunity to care for your pet.

Alyssa H.
Practice Manager
Black Mountain Animal Hospital – Rancho Peñasquitos
Go elsewhere. They charged me almost DOUBLE what the E.R. charged me. And in all.my life I have never seen a waiting room at a vet EMPTY. Should have been the first sign to leave.

This place is extremely petty about money. Was only trying to get an X-ray done and didn’t need another exam so booked here only for that purpose.

They treated 15 minutes late as 30 minutes late and tried to get me to leave my dog so they can see her in between appointments. They told me to come back around 2:30 to wait up to 90 minutes for a vet to see my dog in between appointments.

When I tried to reschedule they treated me like I didn’t show up and then proceeded to charge me more and then gaslight me as if I didn’t show up multiple times when I had showed up and they just pushed me aside because they wanted to get to lunch.

They act complacent because they clearly have enough customers there and do not care about your business or your time.

Do not book with them unless you want to be treated as less than human. Hopefully they treat pets there better.
